anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved on this sample: both outputs render the initial template with course unset, resolve the verdict to e2e pending on the assessed head, omit the merge row with the exact `Not offered: ... merge (e2e pending)` line, make no bypass or ruleset-authority claim anywhere, and offer assess/deliver/stop with deliver recommended and no watch, verification, or merge executed before a numeric pick. Two small regressions in precision worth noting for the After wording: the deliver row dropped the explicit head oid (`watch e2e on abc1234` became `watch e2e until it settles`), which weakens the exact-head evidence contract the Change says to preserve, and it also dropped `rebase on main if needed`, which hid the merge-base-sync authority that a numeric deliver grants. Keeping `deliver - watch e2e on abc1234, repair anything it turns up, rebase on main if needed, repeat until merge is offered` would retain the exact-head binding and sync authorization while still using the shared initial template; the added blank line after the gauntlet header is harmless but inconsistent with Before and should be checked against menus.md.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After correctly switches to the initial template, drops the GitHub-blocked withhold in favor of `Not offered: merge (e2e pending)`, keeps bypass out of the rendering, and recommends deliver for the own PR with no pre-selection watch — but it lost the Evidence line entirely, so the pending resolution is no longer tied to the assessed head abc1234 (the Verdict only says 'verification evidence is pending'). Before carried `Evidence: pending (e2e binding; head abc1234)` and the Change paragraph says exact-head evidence is preserved, so the initial template in menus.md should still render an explicit `Evidence: pending (e2e binding; head <sha>)` line (and have `show evidence` echo it) rather than folding evidence into the Verdict; everything else in After can stay as is.
